name: LANSAKA Marathon 2026
short_description: LANSAKA Marathon 2026 is on Sunday 6 December 2026 at Khiriwong Bridge in Lan Saka, Nakhon Si Thammarat, over 42.195 km, 21.1 km, 10 km and 4 km.
ai_summary: LANSAKA Marathon 2026 is organised by Nakhon Walk Run, with every distance starting and finishing at Khiriwong Bridge in Ban Khiriwong, Lan Saka. The marathon runs out of Ban Khiriwong toward Lan Saka town on an out-and-back road route with two turnarounds. The marathon starts at 03:00 and the half marathon at 04:30.

faqs.question: How much does LANSAKA Marathon 2026 cost?
faqs.answer: Entry is THB 999 for the marathon, THB 899 for the half marathon, THB 699 for the 10 km and THB 399 for the 4 km fun run. VIP entries at THB 2,500 add a Warrix polo shirt, and 21.1 km and 42.195 km finishers receive a finisher shirt.

faqs.question: Where do runners collect race packs for LANSAKA Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: Race packs are collected from 1 to 5 December 2026 at The Kiriwong Valley Villas & Restaurant in Ban Khiriwong. Runners bring their registration confirmation and an ID card, and home delivery is offered only for the 4 km fun run.
